description: Verify an on-chain payment from its transaction hash on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana or Bitcoin (chain is detected if omitted). Returns status and verified. pending, unknown and not_found answers are not charged. Free: 1 a day per IP (counted across the HTTP routes and MCP), then $0.003 per call via x402.

inputSchema.description: Aliases accepted: network=chain, amount=expected_amount, to|recipient|payTo=receiver, asset=token, txid|signature|hash=tx_hash, from|sender=expected_from

min_confirmations.description: Can raise, not lower, the chain default

token.description: Symbol or contract/mint; default USDC (EVM), SOL, BTC

name: verify_payment
title: Payment check
